The name carries a powerful connotation of courage, strength, and victory.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Saudamini was a queen of the Satavahana dynasty, ruling around 150 AD. The name Saudamini carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Saudamini is mentioned in the inscriptions found at Amaravati, which were created during the Satavahana period. She is believed to have ruled as a regent for her son, who was a minor at the time.

historical_references.reference: Saudamini was also a renowned poetess and composer of Sanskrit verses, possibly living in the 7th century AD.
historical_references.context: Saudamini's verses were discovered in the Tamil Nadu region of India and are included in the anthology of Sanskrit poetry known as the Agni Purana.
